title: Use normal text search in clipboard popup by default, not regex (it could be an option)
line: Searching the clipboard history now finds exactly the text you type, including brackets and other symbols
explanation: The clipboard popup built a JavaScript RegExp from the search field and used it as the proxy model's filterRegularExpression. Characters like . and * acted as wildcards, so 't.x' also matched 'plain text item', and an unbalanced '(' threw 'Invalid regular expression' and left the list unfiltered. The filter now uses KSortFilterProxyModel's filterString with case-insensitive matching, and the selection reset moves to onFilterStringChanged.

commits.message:
klipper: search the clipboard popup as plain text, not a regex

The popup's search field was turned into a regular expression, so typing
( or [ gave an invalid pattern that filtered nothing and . or * matched
other text. Filter with the typed text as a case-insensitive string.

BUG: 509574

patches.diff:
From 03d0bd4f2b9baf20bad2bf3bdf1cab2b191f03d0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:09:58 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] klipper: search the clipboard popup as plain text, not a
 regex

The popup's search field was turned into a regular expression, so typing
( or [ gave an invalid pattern that filtered nothing and . or * matched
other text. Filter with the typed text as a case-insensitive string.

BUG: 509574
---
 klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardMenu.qml | 5 +++--
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardMenu.qml b/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardMenu.qml
index b067c9c8af..9cb588cfea 100644
--- a/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardMenu.qml
+++ b/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardMenu.qml
@@ -457,8 +457,9 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
         model: KItemModels.KSortFilterProxyModel {
             sourceModel: clipboardMenu.model
             filterRoleName: "display"
-            filterRegularExpression: RegExp(filter.text, "i")
-            onFilterRegularExpressionChanged: {
+            filterString: filter.text
+            filterCaseSensitivity: Qt.CaseInsensitive
+            onFilterStringChanged: {
                 menuListView.currentIndex = 0;
                 menuListView.positionViewAtBeginning();
                 hoverBlock.reset();
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Searching 't.x' also lists 'plain text item' (the dot acts as a wildcard)
Searching '(' filters nothing: all items stay listed
Search stays case-insensitive: 'PLAIN' finds 'plain text item'

review.text: Clean, idiomatic QML fix replacing RegExp-based filtering with KSortFilterProxyModel's plain-text filterString while preserving case-insensitivity and the selection/scroll/hover-block reset handler. The screenshots thoroughly verify literal matching of regex metacharacters ('.', '(') and case-insensitive search. Not adding a regex toggle keeps the clipboard popup UI uncluttered and matches KDE VDG standards.
